shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: three hundred miles apart, but [[we still send the storm radar]] twenty minutes before the rain hits either house.

caption:
we were never built for long phone calls on a tuesday.
he just watches the yellow clouds moving toward my town, and i track his.
send this to your dad if he still texts you to roll the windows up when the wind picks up.

#dad #dadquotes #fatherdaughter #fatherson
alt: a single slide about staying connected to dad across hundreds of miles by texting the storm radar before it rains.
